We reviewed the July invoice (3789) and saw a ~42% increase in billed units compared with June, without a corresponding change in traffic on our side. We need this for our finance team to approve payment. Please advise next steps and ETA — ideally within 72 hours.

Hi Liam,

I pulled the tokenized usage for the July billing window and compared it against Orbitive's provided API key list. Summary:
- There is a single endpoint ("/v1/embeddings/batch-index") that shows a sustained increase in prompt-token length starting on 2026-07-12.
- The spike correlates with a client-side deploy that added a metadata field to the prompt; our tokenizer (we updated tokenizer rules in late June) treats that field as whitespace before the model call for older traffic, but in your new payload the field contains long concatenated tags which increased token count per call by ~1.8x for that endpoint.
- Raw numbers: June billed tokens for that endpoint: 12,430,000. July billed tokens: 22,450,000. Delta = 10,020,000 tokens.

Attached are: redwood-usage-export-2026-07.csv (our per-key export) and usage-diff-2026-07.csv (row-level diff we computed matching your API keys).

Recommendation:
1) Issue a one-time credit to neutralize the duplicated tokens attributable to the changed prompt composition for July (we recommend crediting the delta of 10,020,000 tokens).
2) Recalculate VAT once we have your VAT registration (reverse-charge) to zero-rate the VAT portion of the credited amount if applicable.

I'll mark these findings as provisional until Marissa confirms the credit amount and VAT handling. Let me know if you want the raw trace logs for a sample request.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Billing Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-usage-export-2026-07.csv (CSV, 85 KB); usage-diff-2026-07.csv (CSV, 12 KB)
